title: Growth Command Center

context.industry: Technology & IT Services (hybrid software + managed services)

kpis.name: Contribution margin
kpis.formula: (Σ GP − Σ cost to serve) ÷ Σ revenue

kpis.name: Cost to serve
kpis.formula: Σ cost to serve ÷ Σ revenue

kpis.name: Weighted pipeline
kpis.source: Opportunities · CRM probabilities overstate by $5.8–9.8M (review 1 evidence)

kpis.name: Slipped pipeline share
kpis.formula: Σ amount of deals whose close date moved later ÷ pipeline

kpis.name: Renewal exposure (≤90 days)
kpis.formula: Σ contract value expiring within 90 days

kpis.name: Renewal exposure (≤180 days)
kpis.formula: Σ contract value expiring within 180 days

kpis.name: Revenue under high renewal risk
kpis.formula: Σ contract value where renewal risk = High

kpis.name: Realized discount
kpis.formula: 1 − Σ actual price ÷ Σ list price

kpis.name: Revenue in At-Risk accounts
kpis.formula: revenue of At Risk accounts ÷ total

kpis.name: Q4-26 bookings outlook (P50)
kpis.source: Monte Carlo, evidence-adjusted; P10 $10.4M – P90 $23.6M; CRM view P50 $19.8M

changes.why: First outcome against a recorded prediction (0.83). Error +0.17; proposed learning logged, not yet applied.

changes.what: A002 adoption kept falling: Core 44 → 38, AI Services 58 → 51
changes.why: Decline continues at about 13–15 points per 30 days although the Critical outage S003 was closed. Renewal in 33 days.

changes.what: A012 moved from Healthy to Watch
changes.why: Recorded as a belief change, not an overwrite: Analytics adoption 43 → 36; 2 of 3 products declining. New alert opened.

changes.what: O010 Core Banking cut from $9.0M to $8.1M; CRM probability 0.65 → 0.60
changes.why: Consistent with the CFO's budget-reduction request (22 Sep). The margin decision of 30 Sep caps any discount at 12% without CRO approval.

changes.what: A004 Retail Analytics advanced to Qualified and grew to $2.3M
changes.why: Follows the new retail analytics initiative identified 27 Sep.
One of three at-risk signals improved; service breach and adoption decline persist, so the alert stays open with an update.

drivers.text: Service failure remains the leading driver in A002 and A006: adoption keeps falling after incidents close, so fixing tickets is not the same as restoring value.
drivers.evidence: Product_Usage A002 −12.9 points/30d after S003 closed; Service_Cases

drivers.text: Pipeline fell $2.0M, but $1.6M of it converted to bookings; only the O010 scope cut ($0.9M) is value lost.
$56M (57%) of contracted revenue renews within 90 days, including the healthy A001 ($15M, 15 Dec) — concentration in time, not just in accounts.

next.text: Q4-26 bookings most likely around $17.1M (P10 $10.4M – P90 $23.6M), up $0.2M from the last review's $16.9M because O009 is now booked.
next.basis: Evidence-adjusted Monte Carlo; no win/loss history yet

next.text: A002 renewal remains at risk (~0.60), and more likely to worsen than improve while adoption declines.
next.basis: Rules tier; trend from two snapshots only

next.text: A012 may become the fourth at-risk account if Analytics adoption continues to fall at the current rate.

actions.text: Confirm what happened in the A002 CIO meeting planned for 8 Oct; record it as an outcome
actions.impact: Closes the loop on the main recommendation

actions.text: Adoption recovery plan for A002 (Core, AI Services) — not just incident closure
Check Auto-Renew notice windows for A002 and A006
Investigate A012 Analytics decline with the champion
Refresh the Marketing feed (23 days stale) before the next engagement analysis

unsupported: Pipeline coverage (needs a period target or quota)
Win rate (needs at least 10 closed outcomes including losses (have 1 won, 0 lost))
Net revenue retention (NRR) (needs prior-period revenue per customer (two revenue snapshots))
Gross revenue retention (GRR) (needs prior-period revenue per customer)
CAC / CAC payback (needs sales and marketing cost by period (only campaign spend is present))
